summary.headline: Contents of Marcianus Excerpts
summary.text: Table of contents for excerpts from Marcianus 334 and Marcianus 335, listing Chaldean twelve-year cycles, Achmes on decans, Dorotheus on illness and interventions, planetary nature and configurations, and Stephanus on mathematical astrology. Further entries cover sowing, parents, siblings, occupations, star configurations, squares, diameters, migrations, death prediction, sailors’ observations, and indices of writers and other names.
